ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'the Fire full of fuel'?
ai.summary: This phrase, often cited in Shia exegetical traditions regarding the severity of divine punishment, highlights the self-sustaining nature of Hellfire where the fuel itself is abundant and ready, symbolizing the permanence and intensity of the retribution for the disbelievers. It underscores the concept of 'waqood' not merely as material fuel but as a metaphor for the accumulated sins and deeds that feed the fire eternally.
